title: ViewerQuestion
description: A question a viewer types on the phone companion. It is data, never instructions (SECURITY.md): capped at 200 characters, and the server rejects unknown fields. Mirrors ninety.agents.contracts.Question.

session.description: The viewer's session id, made by the server.

player.description: The player the phone is focused on, if any.

t.description: Match time the question was asked at, in seconds.
